clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath the Moonshrine Sanctum, Old Serra'kis lurks in the flooded depths of Blackfathom Deeps. The enormous threshadon is hidden in a submerged cave, and deadly to anyone who seeks him there.

The Twilight's Hammer has made its home in the sunken Moonshrine Ruins. Beneath the Moonshrine Sanctum, dark waters conceal older, wilder things. Old Serra'kis, the largest threshadon in the sunken temple, lurks in the Forgotten Pool, a flooded cave beneath the ruins where few would think to look.

To reach Old Serra'kis, you must dive deep beneath the temple floor into a flooded cavern. No air pockets break the water, making the cave as deadly as the beast within. Cornered in the murk, Serra'kis shows an unnatural resilience. He drains life from his attackers with shadow energy, sustaining his own vitality in the darkness.
